title: agentarceval: an architecture evaluation method for foundation model based agents
core_idea: Introduce AgentArcEval, a purpose-built evaluation method for architectures of foundation-model-based agents that accounts for their compound architectures, autonomous and non-deterministic behavior, and continuous evolution; supplemented by a catalogue of agent-specific general scenarios to guide generation of concrete evaluation scenarios.
tldr: Presents AgentArcEval, a specialized method and scenario catalogue for evaluating the architectures of foundation-model-based agents, addressing their unique characteristics and enabling systematic scenario-driven assessment.
